Social Security benefits discussed for recipients and survivors

Social Security benefits for survivors and recipients are being discussed. A death benefit of $255 is provided to some families, a rule unchanged since 1954. Additionally, a proposed plan could offer eligible survivors monthly benefits and a yearly boost of $2,400 to recipients.
